snippet.title: Red Leaves (TRAILER)
snippet.description:
Red Leaves is a short story made in RPGMaker featuring a spin on the Red Riding Hood story with creative liberties. Guide Red through her time loop and die many, many times. Find new ways to kill the wolf and maybe spot some secrets down the way. And don't forget to have a chat with that woodcutter over there, as much as he'd like you to leave him alone.
Somewhat a glorified visual novel. If you don't like reading a lot of words, this may not be for you...

Coming out sometime this week! You can find its itch.io page here https://sockheadstudios.itch.io/red-leaves

#rpgmaker #rpgmakermv #redleaves
